latest_release.name: EffectCraft v0.24.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* .aep import: every loss detail in the prompt; no false shape loss; Orientation expressions (#3365, #3087) by @arnav-hiwarkar in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3448
* ci: run Harden-Runner on every job by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3508
* Updates: take craft-update from craft-libs main at 6e03f65bf by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3511
* Tests: oracle and fixture files go in an exclusively owned temp directory by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3497
* Vector import: split a document at its images in one traversal by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3514
* Variable stroke: first curve approximation scales its tolerance with the path's extent by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3510
* Mask Interpolation: very large shapes skip shape contexts and search coarsely by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3512
* Warp Stabilizer: subspace smoothing visits only the trajectories seen on each frame by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3507
* Logging: continue a message's line breaks on indented lines by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3009
* Lottie import: index precomp sizes and layers, borrow shape groups, bound font names and warnings by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3007
* UI: ScriptUI images decoded within a size limit; effect detection answers each comp once by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3005
* Project panel: draw vector footage thumbnails at the thumbnail's size by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2998
* Shortcuts: list each binding once and cap the conflict list by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2997
* Engine: name allocators resume each base's suffix instead of retrying from the start by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2996
* Automation: a confined batch can't take a step's params from a reference, and renders refuse folders with outward links by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2930
* Interchange: export ends on folder and precomp cycles; import finds each clip's transitions without scanning the track by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2932
* Puppet: clamp an imported Expansion before padding the outline grid by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2940
* Roto Brush, Object Matte: decode frozen mattes only at the layer's full-resolution grid by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2941
* Simulations: cap the steps a layer time can ask for and bound checkpoints as they are made by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2942
* SVG: bound tessellation, kept geometry, attributes, entity expansion and re-rendering by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2986
* PSD: bounded zip errors, budgeted prediction row, row-bounded PackBits, channel checks before the result by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2987
* Box blur: count repeated edge pixels instead of visiting them by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2990
* Tracking: bounded crop size, Roto chain span and resection copies by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2989
* EPS: bound copies, storage, text outlines, group nesting and font discovery by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2953
* Project: layer name suffixes in one pass; template names bounded and never a parent folder by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2973
* Text: run lookup by bisection, bounded path flattening, font folders and files shared by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storyt
